title: Docker for AI
motto: Containers make "works on my machine" a thing of the past.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Containers make "works on my machine" a thing of the past.

steps.title: Why Docker for AI
cards: You trained a model with PyTorch 2.3 and CUDA 12.4. Your colleague has PyTorch 2.1 and CUDA 11.8. Your model crashes on their machine. Your Dockerfile works on both.
A real AI app is not one script — it's an inference server, a vector database, maybe a web frontend. Docker Compose orchestrates all of these with one command.

steps.title: Multi-service AI stack
steps.body: For this lesson you deploy Postgres with pgvector — the same database shape used in production RAG capstones. Your learner workspace gets a real table, a real connection string, and a health URL.

steps.title: Deploy your workspace database
steps.body: Click Deploy to provision Postgres, run migrations, and get a live health endpoint. This is the same thread as Phase 19 capstones — read, build, deploy.

artifact.name: Learner workspace database
artifact.description: Postgres + pgvector provisioned. Your capstone RAG chatbot will use this same stack — hybrid search, migrations, and a live URL.
